Capture both actual invoked-root dependency contexts including settings/buildscript/included convention, selected producer task, plugins/compiler/metadata and all four consumer classpaths in both module and POM modes.
Accept exact four-file private staging and local library staging; render two deterministic strict-root policies from a separately reviewed complete expectation manifest before the cohort.
Keep missing/changed/unlisted/extra/cross-origin/key mismatch and graph substitution negative controls strict; never write TOFU verification metadata mid-run.
Only then run the NEW Windows ordinary consumer/native method in both required metadata modes with held source/runtime/graph/cleanup; the old private Stop remains excluded.
